verdict.rationale: Trivy's official trivy-mcp plugin runs an MCP server that connects Trivy scanning to VS Code and other MCP-enabled AI tools. It advertises 'Natural Language Scanning' for asking questions about security issues, which supports AI-assisted explanation of findings through an external AI client. The evidence does not show AI-driven deduplication or false-positive flagging. Missing for 10: AI deduplication of findings, AI false-positive detection or flagging, documentation of triage workflows beyond natural-language Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
